code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The border color is the stationary field. Shift the complete picture
    # down by one row; retain an extra row only when the old bottom row
    # contains non-background content.
    border = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              if r == 0 or r == h - 1 or c == 0 or c == w - 1]
    background = max(set(border), key=border.count)
    shifted = [[background] * w] + [list(row) for row in grid]
    if all(v == background for v in grid[-1]):
        shifted.pop()
    return shifted
'''
